_meta.purpose: Cost-side conditions for each business's cash balance (prep/nfprep/survival.py).

sources.policy_rate: Bank of Canada, target for the overnight rate (series V39079), yearly average of business days. https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/V39079/json
sources.prime_rate: Bank of Canada, prime business rate (series V80691311), yearly average. https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/V80691311/json
sources.minimum_wage: Ontario general minimum wage, in force for most of each year (changes take effect October 1, and January 1, 2022). $14.00 from 2018, $14.25 Oct 2020, $14.35 Oct 2021, $15.00 Jan 2022, $15.50 Oct 2022, $16.55 Oct 2023, $17.20 Oct 2024, $17.60 Oct 2025. Quoted from memory of the Ontario Employment Standards schedule; check before relying on it.
sources.support: Federal pandemic programs: Canada Emergency Wage Subsidy (up to 75% of wages for businesses with large revenue drops, March 2020 to October 2021, tapering in 2021); Canada Emergency Rent Subsidy (September 2020 to October 2021); Canada Emergency Business Account interest-free loans of up to $60,000 (2020), with up to $20,000 forgiven if $40,000 was repaid by January 18, 2024. Rules summarised from memory; the shares used in the model are simplifications.
sources.cpi: Statistics Canada table 18-10-0005-01, consumer price index, Ontario, all items, annual (2002=100).
